model: Reuse interaction_risk_pilot.fit/predict: family-weighted ridge logistic, fixed training-only Beta(1,1) prior intercept, train-only centering, lambda=1. One fit using six development candidates, module as family. Fixed diagnostic threshold=0.5, no threshold/lambda/feature search.
label: At least one complete response, per-request observation or whole nine-table state difference from original in this fixed protocol, or application failure. Zero means no difference observed, not all-input equivalence.
freeze: Freeze candidates, features, extractor and model settings before any candidate execution. Execute development candidates first; persist fitted coefficients and every target prediction/abstention before executing a target. No target label enters fit.
scope: Relative single-statement SQL-only rewrites of real decompiled classes. Source construction and fresh AST confirm identical surrounding Java/bindings and unchanged other SQL. Existing unknown Java terms remain unknown; scores are conditional structural diagnostics, not whole-module scores. No result-set liveness reasoning or SQL semantics is proved.
evaluation: Report target coverage, same-cohort Brier/log loss versus training prior, fixed-threshold errors, ordering of observed labels, unseen feature values and training-constant columns. Unsupported SQL candidates abstain, remain in the total denominator and still undergo behavior validation.
oracle: Independent full restore per scenario/arm; frozen request order and clocks; same complete data, WAL/fsync and SERIALIZABLE. Compare complete endpoint responses, before/after observations, initial/final nine-table row hashes, commit/rollback traces. Retain invariants even when violated; do not assert candidate correctness. Verify actual candidate class and mutated SQL executed.
exposure: One project, previously seen modules and scenarios; held out from this fit only. Candidate choices use known syntax and likely mechanisms, not blind random samples. Identity/neutral/mutant arms are correlated, shared mutation mechanisms cross modules. Development ranking and target losses are not calibrated generalization probabilities.
stop: Original plus 11 candidates, two scenarios each, at most 408 requests and one model fit. No added samples, target repair, model tuning, performance claim or deployment. Unexpected harness failure preserved; only harness repairs may resume identical candidates/protocol with an explicit deviation record.
